## What I did

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — one JUnit 4 test class in the same package, matching the style of the existing tests (`CSVRecordTest`, `CSVPrinterTest`, `AssertionsTest`): JUnit 4.11, `@Test` / `@Test(expected = ...)`, per-method static imports of `org.junit.Assert.*`, and same-package access to the package-private `Constants`.

### Coverage (public API only)

| Area | Happy path | Boundary / error |
|---|---|---|
| `newFormat(char)` | all optional properties absent, delimiter set | `CR` / `LF` delimiter → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| Predefined `DEFAULT`, `RFC4180`, `EXCEL`, `MYSQL`, `TDF` | every getter asserted against expected value | `DEFAULT` vs `RFC4180` inequality |
| `withDelimiter` | value changes, source unchanged, new instance | line-break → IAE |
| `withCommentStart(char/Character)` | sets marker, `isCommentingEnabled()` true | `null` disables; line-break → IAE |
| `withEscape(char/Character)` | sets, `isEscaping()` true | `null` disables; line-break → IAE |
| `withQuoteChar(char/Character)` | sets, `isQuoting()` true | `null` disables; line-break → IAE |
| `withQuotePolicy` / `withRecordSeparator(char/String)` / `withNullString` | value + derived flags; `null` disables null-handling | — |
| `withSkipHeaderRecord` / `withIgnoreEmptyLines` / `withIgnoreSurroundingSpaces` | toggle both directions, source immutable | — |
| `withHeader` | distinct elements stored; empty array is non-null; defensive copy on both input and `getHeader()` output | duplicate elements → IAE (the `testDuplicateHeaderElements` concern) |
| chained `with*` calls | all 11 settings preserved simultaneously | — |
| `equals` / `hashCode` | reflexive; equivalent independently-built instances equal + equal hashCode + reconstruct `DEFAULT`; no-op `with` returns equal instance | `null`, wrong type, differing delimiter, differing header → not equal |
| `toString` | contains `Delimiter`, `QuoteChar`, `EmptyLines:ignored`, `SkipHeaderRecord`, `Escape`, `Header` fragments as configured | absent fragments verified absent |
| `format(Object...)` | `""`, `"a,b,c"`, delimiter-triggered quoting, `Quote.ALL`, leading-space quoting, custom delimiter, MySQL escaping | `Quote.NONE` without escape → `IllegalStateException`; `null` array → `NullPointerException` |
| `parse(Reader)` | parses records & values; header names map to values; `getHeaderMap()` indices | `null` reader → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `Serializable` | round-trip preserves delimiter, quote char, separator, flags | — |
